name: Summon Skeletons Necromancer
summary: League-start minion build. Skeletons do the damage, so a bad weapon is not a brick: cap your resistances, keep your minions alive, and the damage arrives with the gem levels. No required uniques, which is why it is the first build the pipeline proves.

pros.text: No required uniques; the league-start gear is the gear the guide shows.
Cheap to start: gem levels carry damage, not an expensive weapon.
Minions take the hits, so a mistake is usually recoverable.
Damage scales cleanly with gem levels and minion supports.
Good sustained damage against bosses that stay in one place.
Gear slots are flexible; resistances and life are the only hard requirements.

cons.text: Minion AI and positioning decide fights more than your own aim.
You are fragile when the minion wall breaks or you are caught alone.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a well-geared melee build.
Offerings need corpses, so the damage rotation has setup.
Many gems compete for slots and links.
Leveling with skeletons is clunky before the first minion notables.

summary.text: Summon Skeletons Necromancer is a league-start minion build that measures 214.3k at red maps and 413.1k at pinnacle. Gem levels and minion supports carry the damage, the skeletons take the hits, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with skeletons and a minion damage support, then keep the swarm between you and the pack. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 75 damage; the second measures 367. A mana flask covers the expensive early summons.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 214.3k damage, 30193 effective life and 13117 physical max hit. Keep the skeletons between you and the pack, cap elemental resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 413.1k damage with 35096 effective life and 12601 physical max hit. Refresh the skeletons before the burst, keep Flesh Offering up, and move when the boss turns.
